## Supervision
::: hanging-indent
**Master Thesis Supervision**, Pedagogical Sciences, University of Groningen, Groningen \| 2026–2027\
Supervising a Master's thesis on piloting computer-based tests of cognitive functioning and analyzing the resulting data.

**Bachelor Supervision**, Pedagogical Sciences, University of Groningen, Groningen \| 2025–2026\
Supervised a group of Bachelor students on parametric and nonparametric Item Response Theory (IRT) analyses, guiding their methodological choices, data analyses, and interpretation of results.
:::

## Courses
::: hanging-indent
**IRT Workshop**, Pedagogical Sciences, University of Groningen, Groningen \| 2025–present\
Taught practical sessions on the application of parametric and nonparametric Item Response Theory (IRT) methods.

**Test Theory**, Pedagogical Sciences, University of Groningen, Groningen \| 2025–present\

**Research Methods and Techniques**, Teacher Education, University of Groningen, Groningen \| 2025–2026\
Supervised practical sessions.

**Statistics II**, Psychology, University of Groningen, Groningen \| 2022–2025\
Taught seminars on the theory and application of basic statistical methods, including multiple linear regression, mixed ANOVA, and Bayesian statistics, using JASP.
